data.name: Fisher
starting_equipment_notes: Favorite fishing lure or oilskin boots

feature.name: Harvest the Water
desc: You have advantage on ability checks made using fishing tackle. When suitable water contains edible aquatic life, you can maintain a poor lifestyle while fishing and catch enough food each day for yourself and up to ten other people.

fishing_tale: A catch dragged the boat for miles
A ghostly fish only you could see
A giant clam and an enormous pearl
A fish that blotted out daylight
An underwater passage to a terrible place
A doomed romance with an aquatic being

personality_traits: I respect people who earn their living through hard work.
I become calm when I can see open water.
ideals: Work: steady effort carries people through bad weather.
Balance: take what you need without exhausting the waters that feed you.
bonds: A particular stretch of water and the people who depend on it matter deeply to me.
flaws: I can become fixated on proving one impossible fishing story true.

data.name: Marine
starting_equipment_notes: Folded flag bearing your ship or unit insignia

feature.name: Steady
desc: You can travel for twice the normal daily travel time, up to 16 hours, before forced-march effects begin. You are also practiced at finding a safe route for a vessel to come ashore.

hardship_endured: Nearly drowned while hiding from enemies
Paid dearly so comrades could escape
Endured a dangerous stowaway seizure of a ship
Carried a wounded comrade to safety

personality_traits: I stay composed when conditions turn miserable.
I work best as part of a dependable team.
ideals: Teamwork: victory depends on cooperation and communication.
Endurance: hardship is something to be met rather than feared.
bonds: I will not abandon the people who served beside me.
flaws: I can treat ordinary problems like military emergencies.

data.name: Shipwright
starting_equipment_notes: Blank book used for ship plans and notes
One ounce of ink and an ink pen

feature.name: I'll Patch It!
desc: With carpenter's tools and wood, you can restore hull hit points to a water vehicle equal to five times your proficiency bonus. You cannot use this feature on that vehicle again until it has been hauled ashore and fully repaired.

life_at_sea: Worked toward plans for a grand new vessel
Saved a warship with timely repairs
Strengthened a merchant vessel before disaster
Encountered a mysterious presence in the deep

personality_traits: I notice weak joints, warped boards, and bad repairs almost immediately.
ideals: Craft: good work should survive rough water and harder weather.
bonds: A ship or shipyard where I learned my trade still feels like home.
flaws: I have trouble resisting the urge to criticize shoddy workmanship.

data.name: Smuggler
starting_equipment_notes: Fancy leather vest or leather boots

feature.name: Down Low
desc: You know a smuggler network willing to help you lie low. In a city, town, or similarly sized community chosen by the DM, you and your companions can stay free in a safe house that provides a poor lifestyle, and you can keep your presence there secret.

claim_to_fame: Hid stolen spirits inside a whale carcass
Drove stolen goods across a battlefield
Joined a foreign navy as part of a smuggling job
Drifted into the Shadowfell while carrying stolen art
Spent everything to save refugees at a checkpoint
Sold ammunition to both sides of the same conflict

personality_traits: I always notice exits, patrol routes, and places where cargo could disappear.
ideals: Freedom: borders and tariffs should not decide what ordinary people may trade.
bonds: Someone in a port community once hid me when discovery would have ruined me.
flaws: I assume every rule has a price and every official can be worked around.
